evidence: Donatus, Ars minor, Dē verbō: praeteritum plūsquamperfectum, ut lēgeram (not checked)
terms.comment: The past before the past, “more than finished”: lēgeram, I had read. Donatus’s name (fourth century), which the schools shorten to plūsquamperfectum. Lewis & Short has no entry for the tense name. In the pluperfect: tempore praeteritō plūsquamperfectō (Traupman 248).

sources: Lewis & Short: plus · Lewis & Short: perficio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 226, p. 227, p. 248.
